name: sign-in-with-solana
title: Sign In With Solana
description: Authenticates a Solana wallet with a server-issued SIWS challenge, Wallet Standard sign-in, signature verification, and an HTTP-only session.
docs: Requires Next.js App Router. Development uses an ephemeral process-local secret. In production, set SOLANA_AUTH_SECRET to at least 32 random characters and SOLANA_AUTH_ORIGIN to the canonical HTTPS origin.
